## Eccentric Overload Training

Eccentric actions, in which activated muscles are forcibly lengthened, afford the ability to use maximal loads that are 20% to 40% greater than that of concentric actions. This phenomenon has led to speculation that eccentric overload training, employing loads greater than those used during concentric actions, may provide an added anabolic stimulus.
